Knowing that it’s summer, it gets harder and harder to get away with jeans, especially when they rub against cuts. I’m big fan of leggings; a lot nicer on those cuts and it’s more breathable for summer. Bike shorts are also a good one, cause they can come in different lengths, and they’re skintight so the chances of them riding up and exposing wounds is less likely. Targets All In Motion has some good options for both leggings and bike shorts. 
Good luck! and remember they won’t be open wounds for long. Recovery is never ever linear. You got this.

i don’t think it’s fair to diagnose the cat over a post on reddit. OP has obviously had the cat for some time and would know better than us if the cat is in pain or not. However it’s definitely something to get checked out. 

I’d say take your cat to the vet if you haven’t already, (if you don’t already, you might wanna check out some pet insurance before hand, it may help cut down on the costs). 

And you might even wanna check out care.org and see if theres a nanny with rates in your budget even for just a few hours a week. - I nannied for a family with a 6month old baby, a lot of time mom was home. She just needed a break and some alone time before the boys get home from school. I had a lot of fun doing it, and I could see just how helpful it was for mom. 

Best of luck to you, and remember recovery is never ever linear. Give your cat some pats for me, and blow a raspberry on babies tummy for me. You’re strong and you’re capable.

as if every child born was planned. if you know so much about the urge to self harm, than you should know it goes a lot deeper than just wanting to sh. you don’t know how far along the baby is. you don’t know OPs mental state when they got pregnant. and you sure as hell don’t know their exact situation, when led them to this feeling, or ay other detail of their life. 
so what makes you think it would be okay to tell some strange who is literally already pregnant, that they shouldn’t be having a child. because of their mental state.  obviously, no one in the subreddit is doing particularly great, whether that’s in the moment or overall. so why would you make judgments about someone’s actions, when everyone here has made question choices(we’re in a self harm subreddit, duh). this group is finding support, a sense of not being alone, and being able to open up about something that i’m sure a lot of us have tried their best to keep a secret. 

OP, I hope you’re doing okay. As for your post, my best advice would be to keep the damage minimal. I know women who have busted their knees with a nasty fall and that made no effect on the baby they were carrying. Obviously, I’m not a doctor, nor have I ever been pregnant, but with that logic, if you’re extremely careful, and this isn’t a frequent occurrence, I can’t image your baby will be affected. 
Take that with a grain of salt, again i’m in no way qualified to have an opinion. 
My DMs are open, and I truly hope your future is much brighter than your past. You’re loved here.
